info.name: MMIS Backend API - Local UAT + URA/EFRIS Foundation
info.description: Import with the MMIS Local UAT Postman Environment. Login first to populate accessToken. URA/EFRIS entries reflect the implemented URA Partner Service foundation; full EFRIS invoice fiscalization endpoints are not implemented in this backend snapshot.

item.name: 07 URA Partner Service / EFRIS Foundation
item.description: These are current URA Partner Service foundation endpoints. The audit/docs mark full EFRIS invoice submission, mapper, serializer, outbox, and fiscal receipt endpoints as not implemented in this snapshot.

item.name: 08 Onboarding KYC Access Gates
item.description: TIN-now/NIN-next onboarding tests. These requests document the target access gate: email verification and admin approval should permit KYC entry, while full Vendor/Supplier operations unlock only after URA TIN verification or audited override. NIN is captured in v1; NIRA verification is a follow-up integration.

request.description: Creates a vendor applicant. Expected target behavior: applicant can verify email and enter KYC, but must not receive full vendor operations until TIN verification succeeds.
Creates a supplier applicant. Target behavior mirrors vendor: email verification plus admin KYC approval does not equal full supplier activation.
Verifies applicant email. Current backend creates Stakeholder plus Vendor/Supplier records and starts UNDER_REVIEW/TIN verification when possible.
Use after login to verify role, kycStatus, taxComplianceStatus, and future onboardingAccessStatus once implemented.

item.name: Vendor KYC Setup - TIN NIN Evidence

request.description: Submits vendor KYC evidence. Expected target behavior: full vendor access unlocks only after TIN VERIFIED or OVERRIDDEN.

request.description: Backend-routed TIN verification. Do not call direct URA provider URLs from frontend or normal MMIS UAT collections.
Manual override remains admin-only, reason-required, and auditable.
Regression probe for access bypass. Product clarification still needed for whether this endpoint means KYC approval or full activation.
